applist.Name: Jellyfin
applist.Overview:
Jellyfin is a free software media system that puts you in control of managing and streaming your media.

    It is an alternative to the proprietary Emby and Plex, to provide media from a dedicated server to end-user devices.

    This container requires host networking to work correctly.

    Use the WebUI link to finish the first-run wizard, then add your libraries.
applist.Requires: A valid media library. amd64 or arm64.

@attributes.Name: App Data
@attributes.Description: Where Jellyfin stores its database, metadata and transcode cache. Put this on your cache pool.

@attributes.Name: PUID
@attributes.Description: User ID of the user that will own the media files.

applist.Name: Duplicati
applist.Overview:
Duplicati is a backup client that securely stores encrypted, incremental, compressed backups on cloud storage services and remote file servers.

    This container requires host networking to work correctly.
applist.Requires: A backup destination: S3, WebDAV, SFTP or a mounted share.

applist.Name: Vast.ai Monitor
applist.Overview:
Adds a dashboard tile for your Vast.ai host machines.

    Shows each machine's rental state, live hourly earnings and GPU temperature with colour thresholds.

Branch.TagDescription: Latest stable release from the author.
